title: 2021 AMC 10B Problem 21
statement: A square piece of paper has side length \(1\) and vertices \(A,\) \(B,\) \(C,\) and \(D\) in that order. As shown in the figure, the paper is folded so that vertex \(C\) meets edge \(\overline{AD}\) at point \(C',\) and edge \(\overline{BC}\) intersects edge \(\overline{AB}\) at point \(E.\) Suppose that \(C'D = \frac{1}{3}.\) What is the perimeter of \(\triangle AEC'?\)

solutions.text:
Use coordinates with \(A=(0,1),\) \(B=(0,0),\) \(C=(1,0),\) and \(D=(1,1).\) Since \(C'D=\frac13,\) we have \(C'=(\frac23,1),\) so \(AC'=\frac23.\)

The fold reflects \(C\) to \(C',\) so the image of side \(BC\) is the line through \(C'\) and \(E.\) Reflecting \(B=(0,0)\) across the perpendicular bisector of \(CC'\) gives \((-\frac{2}{15},\frac25).\) The line through this point and \(C'\) meets \(AB\) at \(E=(0,\frac12).\)

Thus \(AE=\frac12,\) and

\[EC'=\sqrt{\left(\frac23\right)^2+\left(\frac12\right)^2}=\frac56.\]

The perimeter of \(\triangle AEC'\) is

\[\frac12+\frac23+\frac56=2.\]

Thus, the answer is A .
hints: A fold is a reflection, so the crease is the perpendicular bisector of \(CC'\)
